additional_concerns: The source states both “will take immediate effect” and “will take effect on 28 November 2025 (Effective Date).” These may coincide or concern different implementation details; the supplied text does not resolve that relationship or identify the legally relevant assessment event.

Preserving an existing application process does not expressly establish an enduring exclusion from substantive relief. The formula fixes pending status at commencement and excludes the associated change even after possible approval, withdrawal or replacement; that extension needs authority.
